plot_timeline: plot a timeline of events from a pandas DataFrame with calibrated start and end columns
prepare_timeline_gpu_events: prepare GPU events DataFrame for timeline visualization by filtering ranks, iterations, and streams
plot_timeline_gpu_kernels: plot a timeline of selected GPU kernels from a DataFrame with optional rank and stream filters
plot_timeline_gpu_kernels_from_trace: plot a timeline of selected GPU kernels directly from a Trace object with optional filters
simplify_name: simplify a kernel name by removing parentheses, angle brackets, void prefix, and truncating long names
